required_conditions_i18n.zh-TW: 河谷／河面霧氣生成（低雲覆蓋與近飽和濕度，provisional 未校準）；降水不足以沖散霧；弱風 (provisional, owner 實務門檻)
required_conditions_i18n.en: River-valley / river-surface fog forming (low-cloud cover and near-saturated humidity, provisional uncalibrated); precipitation not strong enough to wash the fog out; light wind (provisional, owner's field threshold).
required_conditions_i18n.ja: 河谷・川面の霧の発生（下層雲の覆いとほぼ飽和の湿度、暫定・未校正）。降水は霧を洗い流すほどでないこと。弱風（暫定・オーナーの実務基準）。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 河面霧帶連續；橋身半隱半現輪廓；對岸城市輪廓被霧隱去一半
boosters_i18n.en: Continuous fog band on the river; the bridge half-hidden, half-revealed; the far city skyline half-erased by fog.
boosters_i18n.ja: 川面に連続する霧の帯。半隠れ半現れの橋。霧に半分消える対岸の街の輪郭。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 強降水沖散霧；強風吹散河谷霧；霧過濃完全遮蔽橋身成白牆
penalties_i18n.en: Heavy precipitation washing the fog out; strong wind scattering the valley fog; fog so thick it becomes a white wall hiding the bridge entirely.
penalties_i18n.ja: 強い降水が霧を流す。強風が谷霧を散らす。霧が濃すぎて橋を完全に隠す白壁になる。

best_time_i18n.zh-TW: 清晨河谷霧生成時段為主；白天霧退或夜間燈光霧景偶有機會
best_time_i18n.en: Mainly the early-morning window when river-valley fog forms; occasional chances when daytime fog lifts, or on foggy lit-up nights.
best_time_i18n.ja: 主に早朝、河谷の霧が発生する時間帯。日中に霧が晴れる直後や、ライトアップの霧の夜に機会があることもある。

best_season_i18n.zh-TW: 全年候選；河谷霧以秋冬清晨較常見，實際成立與否以當日資料為準
best_season_i18n.en: All-year candidate; river-valley fog is more common on autumn/winter mornings, and whether it forms is judged from the day's data.
best_season_i18n.ja: 通年の候補。河谷の霧は秋冬の早朝に多い。成立するかは当日のデータで判断する。

required_conditions_i18n.zh-TW: 能見度 >= 5 km（provisional, owner-corrected）且 AOD <= 0.4；低雲 <= 30% 不遮蔽主體；降水 < 0.2 mm/h
required_conditions_i18n.en: Visibility >= 5 km (provisional, owner-corrected) and AOD <= 0.4; low cloud <= 30% not hiding the subject; precipitation < 0.2 mm/h.
required_conditions_i18n.ja: 視程 5 km 以上（暫定・オーナー訂正）かつ AOD 0.4 以下。下層雲 30% 以下で主役を隠さない。降水 0.2 mm/h 未満。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 遠景輪廓清楚；中高雲少量；低角度暖光加分
boosters_i18n.en: Crisp distant outlines; a little mid/high cloud; low-angle warm light adds to the scene.
boosters_i18n.ja: 遠景の輪郭がくっきり。少量の中・上層雲。低角度の暖かい光はプラス。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 霾害／AOD 偏高；低雲遮蔽橋身與對岸；濃霧白牆
penalties_i18n.en: Haze / elevated AOD; low cloud hiding the bridge and the far shore; thick fog as a white wall.
penalties_i18n.ja: 霾やAODの増加。下層雲が橋と対岸を隠す。濃い霧の白壁。

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"八里崁頭里山側眺望點 Camera Zone (provisional, owner-provided coordinate)","subject":"blazing sunset sky over the Tamsui River + Guandu Bridge silhouette"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 眺望點合法可達且安全
condition_variants.required_conditions: 日落時窗成立；低雲 <= 55%（provisional）不封鎖霞色；中高雲 20-70% 供染色；降水 < 0.3 mm/h；AOD <= 0.6
condition_variants.boosters: 西向透光；中高雲火燒染色；河面反射霞色；橋樑剪影
condition_variants.penalties: 厚低雲封鎖西向地平線；霾害；霧白牆；強降水

required_conditions_i18n.zh-TW: 日落時窗成立；低雲 <= 55%（provisional）不封鎖霞色；中高雲 20-70% 供染色；降水 < 0.3 mm/h；AOD <= 0.6
required_conditions_i18n.en: Sunset window valid; low cloud <= 55% (provisional) not blocking the afterglow; 20-70% mid/high cloud to take the color; precipitation < 0.3 mm/h; AOD <= 0.6.
required_conditions_i18n.ja: 日の入りの時間帯が成立。下層雲 55% 以下（暫定）で残照をふさがない。中・上層雲 20-70% で色づく。降水 0.3 mm/h 未満。AOD 0.6 以下。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 西向透光；中高雲火燒染色；河面反射霞色；橋樑剪影
boosters_i18n.en: Clear light toward the west; mid/high cloud taking the blazing color; the river reflecting the afterglow; the bridge in silhouette.
boosters_i18n.ja: 西向きの光。焼けるように色づく中・上層雲。残照を映す川面。橋のシルエット。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 厚低雲封鎖西向地平線；霾害；霧白牆；強降水
penalties_i18n.en: Thick low cloud blocking the western horizon; haze; fog as a white wall; heavy precipitation.
penalties_i18n.ja: 西の地平線をふさぐ厚い下層雲。霾。白壁の霧。強い降水。
